name: TLS 1.0 / TLS 1.1
concern: Critically insecure legacy protocols forbidden by modern standards (RFC 8996).
pqc_migration_path: Upgrade immediately to TLS 1.3 with hybrid key exchange enabled.

name: TLS 1.2
concern: Does not support post-quantum hybrid key exchange natively in most standard clients; vulnerable to HNDL unless upgraded.
pqc_migration_path: Migrate server configuration to prefer or mandate TLS 1.3.

name: TLS 1.3
concern: Classical key exchange vulnerable to HNDL unless hybrid post-quantum groups (e.g., X25519MLKEM768) are enabled.
pqc_migration_path: Configure hybrid PQC key exchange groups (X25519+ML-KEM-768 / secp256r1+ML-KEM-768).

name: JWT RS256 (RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5 with SHA-256)
concern: Asymmetric RSA signatures vulnerable to Shor's algorithm; requires migration across token issuers and all verifiers.
pqc_migration_path: Plan migration to Composite Hybrid Signatures (e.g., RS256+ML-DSA-65) or dual-token validation architecture.

name: JWT ES256 (ECDSA P-256 with SHA-256)
concern: Elliptic curve discrete log vulnerable to Shor's algorithm.
pqc_migration_path: Plan migration to Composite Hybrid Signatures (ES256+ML-DSA-65).

name: SSH-RSA
concern: Legacy SHA-1 based signature scheme and classical RSA key exchange.
pqc_migration_path: Migrate to OpenSSH hybrid KEM (sntrup761x25519-sha512@openssh.com or mlkem761x25519-sha512).
